title:
FORTIUS AQUA
Creatine + Electrolyte Performance Formula
description:
Creatine Hydration Powder is a blend that brings together creatine monohydrate and key electrolytes to support consistent training and muscular energy. Creatine helps fuel short-burst power by supporting ATP regeneration, allowing your muscles to perform at their full potential. Electrolytes like magnesium, sodium, and potassium help maintain hydration and support normal muscle and nerve function.

Whether you're lifting, running, or completing high-intensity training, this formula supports stamina and physical output. It’s designed to help maintain performance during challenging sessions and provide the minerals your body uses during sweat loss. The result is a balanced combination that supports strength, endurance, and fluid balance.

With a smooth flavor and easy mixability, this product fits perfectly into both pre- and post-workout routines. The clean ingredient list ensures you get exactly what you need without unnecessary additives. It’s an excellent daily companion for athletes, active individuals, and anyone looking to support their overall physical performance.*


Ingredients: Creatine (as Creatine Monohydrate) 5,000 mg, Magnesium (as Magnesium Malate) 60 mg, Sodium (as Sea Salt) 1,000 mg, Potassium (as Potassium Chloride) 200 mg, Natural Flavors, Stevia Extract (Leaf), Silicon Dioxide.
Flavor: Lemon
Manufacturer's country: USA
Product amount (oz/lbs/g): 10.6 oz / 0.7 lbs / 300 g
Gross weight (oz/lbs/g): 13.6 oz / 0.85 lbs / 386 g
Suggested use: As a dietary supplement, adults mix one (1) scoop (10g) with 6-8 oz (177-237ml) of water or favorite beverage daily.
Warning: Do not exceed recommended dose. Pregnant or nursing mothers, children under the age of 18, and individuals with a known medical condition should consult a physician before using this or any dietary supplement.
KEEP OUT OF THE REACH OF CHILDREN. DO NOT USE IF SAFETY SEAL IS DAMAGED OR MISSING. STORE IN A COOL, DRY PLACE

*These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
